question: Please provide the full name of the away team that scored the most goals.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "matches_augmented_with_away_team" AS SELECT m.match_api_id, m.away_team_api_id, m.away_team_goal, t.team_long_name AS away_team_long_name FROM table_2 m LEFT JOIN table_1 t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT away_team_long_name AS away_team_full_name,
         SUM(away_team_goal) AS total_away_goals
  FROM matches_augmented_with_away_team
  GROUP BY away_team_long_name
),
maxv AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_away_goals) AS max_goals FROM agg
)
SELECT a.away_team_full_name, a.total_away_goals
FROM agg a
JOIN maxv m ON a.total_away_goals = m.max_goals
ORDER BY a.away_team_full_name;
